title: Tooling: 2.63× faster production hosted digest via fragment reuse with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, production p111-tuned `audit_hosted_k.py` still hashed every mapped instruction with a fresh `json.dumps`. Matthieu Pascal’s opt-in adapter `research/bit-hosted-digest-fastpath/` (incorporated [#1874](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1874)) already proved JSON-fragment reuse with identical hosted-audit receipts. This PR wires that equivalent digest into the **production** auditor used by adapt9p-parameterized PR589 hosted audits.

Path: `research/e8-bit-p111-tuned/vendor/pr510/e8-r480-nine-stage/vendor/e8-r715-eleven-stage-whole/code/audit_hosted_k.py`.

No certificate κ pins change. Same-tip provenance hygiene:
- `research/bit589-width7-windows-seed72/`, `research/selected-bit-hosting-audit/`, and `research/r439-abc-hosted-invoice/` demote `audit_hosted_k.py` to **provenance** (pairwise-era digest) and drop it from live `VERIFY.json` inputs — a naive sha refresh against an old `base_commit` is invalid for research-packages pin checks.
- `research/bit-hosted-digest-fastpath/` vendors pairwise-era bytes as local `baseline.py` and compares against that file (production path is provenance-only).

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched. Adapt9p’s five hosted-auditor anchors are preserved.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 with `taskset -c 0`, five alternating fresh-process pairs gave median complete parameterized PR589 hosted-audit wall time **34.880 → 13.268 s (2.63×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Emitted-program digest stays `96c7ad2e…` (7,843,392 events; 16 mutants).

Package: `research/bit-hosted-digest-production/`.
Tip: `b5c3b567f13b18881161cf6c445e4ef251870558`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/bit-hosted-digest-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/bit-hosted-digest-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-hosted-digest-production
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-hosted-digest-fastpath --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit589-width7-windows-seed72 --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-hosting-audit --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-abc-hosted-invoice --check-only
taskset -c 0 python3.12 -I -B research/bit-hosted-digest-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_BIT_HOSTED_DIGEST_PRODUCTION events=7843392 … corruption=audit_assertion certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/bit-hosted-digest-production outcome=completed
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS
PASS_IDENTICAL_BIT_HOSTED_DIGEST_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Temp-copy digest foil rejects via audit assertion. Package gates under `-O` still launch asserting children. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated auditor change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): Matthieu Pascal’s `research/bit-hosted-digest-fastpath/` / [#1874](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1874) (opt-in fragment digest; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2257) / [#2263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2263) / [#2276](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2276) / [#2320](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2320) / [#2329](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2329) (same production-promotion + provenance pattern). No competing open PR on this production `audit_hosted_k.py` at refresh.
